name: setup-manaflow-ai-hairline-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces: theme files for color, the terminal palette and proportions (Hairline in zinc, the default, plus Slate and Stone, each dark and light), settings for one corner radius across panes, tabs, cards and popovers, a two-pixel focus ring, no glass or wallpaper anywhere, a dense sans in the chat, and stylesheets that draw cards, your prompt and the composer as one-pixel outlines with no shadow. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
